retrievalProfile.description: Generates a nostalgic 1970s-style portrait featuring a couple in period-accurate fashion with soft-focus backgrounds and heavy-weight psychedelic serif typography.
excludeWhen: modern high-definition digital photography is required
neon or high-saturation color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, grainy, soft-focus photograph of a couple embracing outdoors, framed by a vertical architectural element like a lamppost, featuring stacked decorative serif typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject interaction creates a central diagonal lean against a vertical anchor
Typography occupies the negative space of the blurred background
Color palette harmonizes between the subject's clothing and the architectural surroundings
Soft-focus fountain spray provides a textured, low-contrast backdrop
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and soft-focus lens effect
Earth-toned color palette dominated by ochre, tan, and muted blue
Stacked, centered decorative serif typography with rounded terminals

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium-full shot of a couple positioned slightly right of center, leaning against a dark vertical lamppost.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A dark, ornate vertical lamppost on the right edge provides structural stability.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast typography in the top left, move down the woman's suede jacket, and follow the vertical line of the lamppost.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and center-left areas are occupied by a blurred fountain, providing a canvas for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and tan (suede jacket, pants, background stone)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Muted slate blue (man's suit, typography fill)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed tonal range; shadows are lifted and highlights are soft.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight display serif with psychedelic curves
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick stems with high-contrast thin hairlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature exaggerated swashes on 'J', 'L', and 'M'
Internal counters are small and circular
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying colors (blue for name, ochre for title) to create hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Wrought iron fence at the bottom edge
Vertical lamppost as a framing device

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s curves and heavy weight
Provides the necessary rounded, heavy-weight feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus 1970s film photograph of a couple embracing next to a dark ornate lamppost. The woman wears a tan suede jacket and pants. The man wears a blue striped suit and a patterned neckerchief. Background is a blurred stone fountain. Heavy film grain, warm earth tones.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked, centered all-caps text in the top left corner using a heavy psychedelic serif font. The top line should be muted blue; the subsequent lines should be ochre tan. Apply a slight grain texture to the text to match the photo.

verificationChecks: Is the typography a heavy-weight 70s serif?
Is the color palette restricted to earth tones and muted blues?
Does the image have a soft-focus, grainy film quality?
Is the lamppost used as a vertical anchor on the right?

avoid: Digital noise instead of film grain

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'halo' artifacts around text; it should look printed on the grain.
Ensure the suede texture is visible despite the soft focus.
Verify the vertical lamppost is dark and provides a strong anchor.
Confirm the typography is stacked and centered in the top-left quadrant.
Check that the man's neckerchief has a vintage pattern.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s Portrait + Suede/Earth Tones + Soft Focus Fountain + [Psychedelic Serif Typography]
